headline: Premier League MW7 Washup: Tottenham reel from Brighton collapse as Man City sit clear on 21 points
whyCareReason: Brighton's stunning 18-minute comeback leaves Tottenham in full crisis mode with 10 points dropped from winning positions, while Manchester City cement total perfection entering the international break.
teaser: Monday in the Premier League: Tactical fallout from Brighton's 3-2 comeback over Spurs sends shockwaves through North London, as Pep Guardiola's Manchester City reign supreme with 21 points from seven matches.
story:
Why this one matters: As the Premier League pauses for the October international break, Matchweek 7 concluded with an afternoon of unbridled tactical chaos that fundamentally reshaped both ends of the table.

At the Amex Stadium on Sunday, Tottenham Hotspur appeared in complete control at 2-0 up thanks to goals from Brennan Johnson and James Maddison. But Fabian Hürzeler's halftime adjustments flipped the contest upside down. Yankuba Minteh struck within three minutes of the restart, Georginio Rutter leveled through individual tenacity, and Danny Welbeck headed home a glorious winner in the 66th minute to seal an unbelievable 3-2 Brighton triumph.

The collapse leaves Ange Postecoglou's side reeling. Spurs have now surrendered 10 points from winning positions in the league this season, marooned in 20th place with just two points from six matches. Meanwhile, Manchester City sit comfortably alone at the summit, boasting a flawless 21 points (7-0-0) ahead of Arsenal (18 points) and Liverpool (15 points). With players now departing for World Cup qualifiers and Nations League duty, the fortnight ahead will bring intense soul-searching across North London.
stakes: Managerial stability at Tottenham, Brighton's push for Champions League qualification, and City's march toward an unprecedented title defense.
rivalryAngle: Tottenham must stew over an embarrassing collapse for two weeks during the break, while Brighton celebrate rising into fourth position.
